meaning:
μηκύνω
(μῆκος), [in LXX: Isa.44:14 (גָּדַל pi.), Eze.12:25, 28 (מָשַׁךְ ni.) * ;]
to lengthen, extend: of causing plants to grow, Isa, l.with; pass. (mid., Swete, in l), to grow: Mrk.4:27.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.
